items.title: A weekend by the sea
sentences: Last August my sister and I took a train to a small coastal town that neither of us had visited before.
The journey took almost five hours, but we enjoyed it because the views from the window were spectacular.
When we arrived, we discovered that the hotel we had booked was on the other side of the town.
There were no taxis at the station, so we had to carry our heavy bags all the way there, up a long, steep hill.
By the time we reached the hotel, we were exhausted, but the owner welcomed us with cold drinks.
After a short rest, we went out to explore, and that evening we had the best seafood of our lives.

explanation.en: The story follows the trip in time: the journey, the arrival, the problem with the hotel, the walk (there = to the hotel), reaching it, and the evening. 'The journey' and 'the station' pick up 'a train'.
explanation.es: La historia sigue el viaje en el tiempo: trayecto, llegada, problema con el hotel, caminata (there = al hotel), llegada y noche. 'The journey' y 'the station' retoman 'a train'.

note.en: There = the hotel, on the other side of town.
note.es: There = el hotel, al otro lado de la ciudad.

cohesionHints.phrase: By the time we reached the hotel

note.en: They were exhausted, so they rested.
